business: SEGMENT: title companies, West Palm Beach
prompt_text: Which title company in West Palm Beach FL is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a clear, independently verified “best” from the information available. **Integrity Land Title** is a reasonable first call: it’s based in West Palm Beach and says it handles title searches, closing documents, escrow, and lien payoffs in-house. **Florida Fidelity Title & Escrow** is another local option, with a West Palm Beach office and residential closing services.

Before choosing, ask each for a written estimate of title, settlement, and other fees; confirm they can meet your closing date and handle your needs (such as remote signing); and check the agency’s current Florida license. Also ask your lender whether it has any requirements. In Florida, you can generally shop for the title/settlement provider, though who selects or pays for the owner’s policy may depend on the contract.
